channel.title: Cain — Devblog
channel.description: Development log for Cain — a 2D action-platformer with deliberate, stamina-based combat and a hand-painted, organic world.

item.title: Filling in the treehouse
item.description: Five new treehouse rooms, and the two bake bugs that turned up once the interiors were properly filled in.

item.title: Reading the forest
item.description: Locking down what The Wake is actually about — a region where you cannot trust what you're looking at until you've learned how to look.

item.title: The world looked pixel'y
item.description: Two complaints about the Nod opening — chunky uneven pixels, and background layers with no shape of their own. Three changes, each independently revertable.

item.title: Nine rooms west
item.description: Planning Nod, the opening region — flat, quiet, sparse, and deliberately not a combat area.
